sourceTitle: Keto Cucumber Lime Gummy Snacks Recipe
sourceText:
Keto Cucumber Lime Gummy Snacks Recipe
By: Keto Summit
Published: Thursday, July 12, 2018 - 12:55am

Ingredients




1 cucumber, peeled (approx 1/2 lb or 225 g)
15-20 fresh mint leaves (or 1 Tablespoon (3 g) mint tea leaves)
Juice from 1/2 lime
1.5 Tablespoons (10 g) gelatin powder
Dash of stevia (optional)

Preparation

1 In a blender, blend the cucumber, mint leaves, lime juice, and stevia. 2 Strain the mixture and place the liquid (approx. 1/2 cup or 120 ml liquid) into a small pot on the stove. 3 Heat on medium heat until the liquid starts to simmer. 4 Stir in the gelatin powder (adding a small amount at a time) until it’s all dissolved. Strain again to remove any lumps that might have formed. 5 Pour into silicone molds (ice cube trays work well) and refrigerate for 2 hours.

About

DESCRIPTION: I’ve been on a collagen and gelatin kick recently! I’ve been making a lot of Keto gummy snacks with gelatin and Keto smoothies with collagen.
